episodeTitle.en: Lessons from scaling Ramp | Sri Batchu (Ramp, Instacart, Opendoor)
episodeTitle.zh: 《Ramp扩展规模的经验教训 | 斯里·巴楚（Sri Batchu，Ramp、Instacart、Opendoor）》

guestBioOfficial.en: Sri Batchu currently leads growth at Ramp, the fastest-growing SaaS business (and fintech business) in history. Previously, he led growth strategy and operations at Instacart and was one of the first 50 employees at Opendoor, where he built, scaled, and managed a variety of business teams, including analytics, sales, and pricing. During his time there, the company grew from $100M to $5B+ in revenue and to 1,500+ people. In this episode, we discuss:• The surprising tactics behind Ramp’s unprecedented early growth• A breakdown of Ramp’s current growth org and growth channels• Why you need to be “failing conclusively”• Ramp’s unique approach to metrics and measurement• Examples of Ramp’s “secret sauce”: a data- and technology-driven approach to everything• Why Sri prioritizes employee autonomy and flexibility over hours worked• Why team structure is a red herring for growth teams, and what Sri focuses on instead• How to set good North Star metrics, and why you should have more than one• Why Sri prefers payback periods over CAC for measuring investment ROI
guestBioOfficial.zh: 斯里·巴楚目前负责Ramp的增长业务，Ramp是史上增长最快的SaaS公司（及金融科技公司）。此前，他在Instacart负责增长战略和运营，并是Opendoor首批50名员工之一，在那里他组建、扩展并管理了包括分析、销售和定价在内的多个业务团队。在他任职期间，公司营收从1亿美元增长至50亿美元以上，员工规模超过1,500人。本期节目中，我们将探讨：• Ramp早期增长背后令人惊讶的策略   • Ramp当前增长组织和增长渠道的解析   • 何为“彻底失败”   • Ramp独特的指标和衡量方法   • Ramp“秘籍”示例：一切事务均以数据和技术为导向   • 斯里为何优先考虑员工自主性和灵活性而非工作时长   • 团队结构为何是增长团队的误区，以及斯里关注的重点   • 如何设定优秀的北极星指标，以及为何需要多个指标   • 斯里为何更青睐投资回报率而非客户获取成本来衡量投资回报率

title.en: Lessons from scaling Ramp | Sri Batchu (Ramp, Instacart, Opendoor)
title.zh: 《Ramp扩展规模的经验教训 | 斯里·巴楚（Sri Batchu，Ramp、Instacart、Opendoor）》

summary.en: Ramp seeded its explosive growth with a 'cap table as a growth strategy' — recruiting influential founders and operators as early investors who became its first customers. Its real edge comes from technologizing every channel: a dedicated growth-engineering team automates sales and a shared 'translation layer' maps every team's metric back to a single north-star metric (dollars of SQL pipeline). Culturally, Ramp runs on velocity — working in days not quarters, two-week sprints, calendar audits, and autonomy over hours rather than hours worked. For B2B growth sequencing Sri recommends founder-led sales, then first sales hires, then low-cost targeted marketing (content, community, events, PR), and only later paid, brand, and SEO. He also argues companies should optimize for payback period over CAC or LTV, and design experiments to 'fail conclusively' by maximizing the treatment effect rather than iterating timidly.
summary.zh: Ramp 之所以能爆发式增长，起点是它把「股权结构表当成增长策略」——拉拢有影响力的创始人和运营者成为早期投资人，而这些人又成了它的第一批客户。它真正的壁垒在于把每个渠道都技术化：一支专门的「增长工程」团队自动化销售流程，并用一套共享的「翻译层」把每个团队的指标都映射回同一个北极星指标（销售合格线索带来的美元金额）。在文化上，Ramp 靠的是「速度」——以天而不是季度为单位工作、两周一个冲刺、做日历审计，看重的是自主权和产出而非工作时长。关于 B2B 增长的顺序，Sri 建议先做创始人主导的销售，再招第一批销售，接着做低成本的精准营销（内容、社群、活动、PR），最后才做付费、品牌和 SEO。他还主张企业应该优化「回收周期」而不是 CAC 或 LTV，并且要做「彻底失败」的实验——把能用的手段都押上，而不是小心翼翼地小步迭代。
